name: KwonHo: The Fist of Heroes
summary:
KwonHo: The Fist of Heroes is a 3D online multiplayer fighting game where players take on the roles of martial artists and test their skills against other players in a variety of locations. Players can customize their character's appearance and choose from one of five fighting styles: Tae Kwon Do, Muay Thai, Tai Chi Quan, Ba Ji Quan, or Judo. Each style comes with over 50 possible moves, which can expand as characters level up.

The game features a Single Match (1v1) mode, a Team Match (2v2 or 3v3) mode, and a Death Match mode which consists of several 1v1 fights where the winner gets to fight the next player on the opposing team until all members of a team have been defeated.
